text:
noah: hi everyone, day 2 here — quick ask: I can sign in but the Console's admin UI (flag management tab) shows 403. who owns granting the flag-manager role for staging?

jen: welcome aboard! :wave: infra usually handles the SSO group membership. ping @taylor_i or open the access request form. did you follow the onboarding checklist link under "Platform access"?

noah: yep followed checklist, it says group added automatically but I don't see redwood-console-staging-managers in my SSO groups.

taylor_i: hey @noah, sorry about that. we batch-provision groups for new hires every morning."I'll add you manually now." Can you confirm your sign-in email?

noah: noah@redwood.com

infra-bot: Access workflow triggered: ticket #ACC-4927 created. Approvers required: manager + infra. ETA manual grant: ~10m.

jen: FYI staging flag-manager != prod flag-manager. For prod we require a short security justification and one extra approver. Staging is fasttrack for devs.

noah: thanks. also need a service token for the feature-flag cli (ffctl) to run locally against staging. Is that a separate request?

jen: yes — create a scoped service account via IAM UI and tag it "ffcli-e2e". Don't request KMS unless you need encrypted secrets. If you do, add a KMS justification (prod KMS needs two approvers).

noah: got it. if you add me to the SSO group, will I see the flags page immediately or is there a cache/ttl?

taylor_i: should be immediate but browser cache or the Console token might need refresh. Do a hard refresh (ctrl+shift+R) and re-open the Console. If still 403, logout and re-login.

infra-bot: Manual grant completed by taylor_i. Group: redwood-console-staging-managers.

noah: confirmed! I can open Flags -> Manage. thank you.

jen: quick note on permissions: 'flag-manager' lets you create/rollout flags in staging. We avoid granting that in prod unless you're on a support rotation. If you need prod read-only ask with manager sign-off.

noah: one last question: where should I post the short runbook for running ffctl locally? want to add it to onboarding docs.

devex: put a short MD in docs/onboarding/platform-access.md and ping #docs-review. Template: command examples, required env vars, how to rotate token. Example snippet you can add:
```
# get token
ffctl auth login --service-account=/secrets/ffcli-e2e.json
# list flags
ffctl flags list --env=staging
```

noah: added draft PR to repo docs: github.com/redwood/docs/pull/67. tagged @devex for review. thanks all! :tada:
